_comment: The daily image queue. A brief is due when its lane's last accepted asset for that id is older than `every` days, so nothing here needs editing to keep the queue alive. `name` is the path under src/<lane>/<day>/ and, when the lane publishes, under published/<lane>/<day>/. `every` is the freshness promise; `site` also carries the page the asset belongs to. `expect` is what the plate must show, and it is what lets the judge call a literal reading of a name a reroll. No prompt carries a shared style tail: the subject and the scene are the brief. `rev` bumps when a prompt is rewritten: a keep made at an older revision no longer counts as fresh, so the old plate is replaced instead of protecting its defect for a whole `every`.

site.intent: a hero, og card or icon for bountystash.com, matt.bountystash.com or concept.bountystash.com

wall.intent: an illustrated desktop wallpaper for a dwl session at 1920x1080 or 1024x600: one scene with a clear subject and focal point, drawn in a definite illustrative style, never a UI panel, an icon or an emblem

blog.intent: a banner image for one blog post at shaoyanji.is-a.dev, cropped to 1200x630 and used for both the in-page hero and og:image

fleet.intent: a nixconfig fleet illustration: docs art, an agent card or a topology figure

badge.intent: a square profile-picture badge for one host on the fleet site, shown at 96px beside the host's name: one recognisable subject with a clear focal point, never a UI panel, an icon sheet or an abstract emblem
